pages.text: So the spaceman goes up and up and up and up and up
pages.illustration_note: A spaceman rising straight up in a tall vertical column of sky, drawn small at the bottom and repeating upward five times to show the five ups.

pages.text: past the clouds and past the birds and past a plane and the plane says hi
pages.illustration_note: The spaceman passing clouds, then birds, then an airplane; the plane has a speech bubble saying 'hi'.

pages.text: and he goes up more and up
pages.illustration_note: The spaceman going higher again, sky getting darker, two more upward bursts above where the plane was.

pages.text: and there's a star and the star is his mom
pages.illustration_note: A big glowing star in dark space, and the star is his mom — draw it as a star that is his mom, not a person beside a star.
The spaceman floating with a huge happy face, arms out, in front of the star.

pages.text: and they eat space soup together forever and ever and ever and ever.
pages.illustration_note: The spaceman and the star-mom eating bowls of space soup together, floating in space; the scene repeats four times across the page for the four evers.

characters.name: The Spaceman
characters.canonical: The spaceman is one single small round-cheeked astronaut drawn in loose lively ink outline with full saturated watercolor fill, a chunky child-sized figure with a big round head about one-third of his height, short stubby arms and legs and rounded mitten hands, wearing a creamy-white puffy spacesuit with a clear round glass bubble helmet through which his whole face is always visible — two big round black eyes with white dot shines, a small round nose, two pink cheek circles and a wide open happy smile — with a bright red helmet ring around the neck, a bright red chest patch, bright red gloves and orange boots, and a little orange backpack tank with two soft trailing puffs, always floating upright with arms lifted as he goes up. IMPORTANT design change (override any of the above that conflicts): On every page keep him EXACTLY like this reference: cream-white suit with RED trim and zipper, a RED square patch on the chest, red helmet ring, red mitten gloves, orange boots. Do NOT use orange suit trim and do NOT draw a control panel on the chest. He always has short tousled brown hair, never blonde or any other colour.

features: big round head, one-third of body height
clear bubble helmet with full face visible through it
two big round black eyes with white shines
stubby mitten hands and arms lifted upward
little orange air tank with two puffs
attributes.size: small chunky child-sized figure, about three heads tall
attributes.clothing: puffy creamy-white spacesuit with red helmet ring, red gloves, red chest patch and orange boots
attributes.expression: so happy — wide open smile, eyes bright and round

characters.name: The Plane that says hi
characters.canonical: The plane is one single friendly cartoon airplane drawn in loose lively ink outline with full saturated watercolor fill, a plump rounded sausage-shaped body twice as long as it is tall with short stubby straight wings and a small triangular tail fin, painted sunny yellow with a bright red nose cone, red wing tips and an orange stripe along its side, with a big round windshield window at the front through which its whole face shows — two round black eyes with white shines, a small button nose and a wide curved smiling mouth — and one wing tipped up as if waving hi.

features: plump sausage body with stubby straight wings
round windshield with full face visible through it
two round black eyes with white shines
attributes.size: about as long as the spaceman is tall
attributes.expression: cheerful and greeting, saying hi with a wide smile

characters.name: The Star who is his Mom
characters.canonical: The star mom is one single big five-pointed star drawn in loose lively ink outline with full saturated watercolor fill, plump rounded points and a soft chubby middle, glowing golden-yellow with warm orange shading in the middle of each point and a thin red-orange rim, about twice as wide as the spaceman is tall, with a complete motherly face on her front — two big warm round black eyes with long lashes and white shines, a small round nose, round rosy pink cheeks and a wide gentle loving smile — and two short soft yellow arm-points that reach out to hug.

features: two big round black eyes with long lashes and white shines
two short point-arms reaching out to hug
attributes.size: big — about twice as wide as the spaceman is tall
attributes.expression: warm, loving, smiling like a mom

contradictions: She is a star AND she is his mom — both true at the same time

characters.name: Space Soup
characters.canonical: The space soup is one single round wide bowl drawn in loose lively ink outline with full saturated watercolor fill, a deep half-circle bowl painted bright red-orange with a yellow rim band, filled with swirly golden-orange soup that has tiny yellow star-shaped pieces floating in it, three little curling steam wisps rising above, and one orange wooden spoon resting in it — always the same single bowl, floating in place.

features: swirly soup with floating star-shaped pieces
orange spoon resting in the bowl
attributes.size: small — fits in the spaceman's two mitten hands

characters.name: The Birds
characters.species: birds (a few, as the child said 'the birds')
characters.canonical: The birds are a few small plump round-bellied cartoon birds drawn in loose lively ink outline with full saturated watercolor fill, each one about a quarter the size of the spaceman with a fat teardrop body, two short rounded wings and a tiny fan tail, painted bright orange with a red wing edge and a small yellow triangular beak, each with a full face of two round black eyes with white dot shines and a cheerful open smiling beak, flapping in a loose little line.

features: two round black eyes with white shines
small yellow triangular beak, open and smiling
attributes.size: small — about a quarter the spaceman's height each

characters.name: The Clouds
characters.canonical: The clouds are soft puffy bumpy-edged clouds drawn in loose lively ink outline with full saturated watercolor fill, each a fat stack of rounded lumps wider than it is tall, painted bright white with pale blue shadow underneath and a warm peachy-orange glow along the top edge, plain and faceless, drifting in a loose row.

attributes.size: large and wide, bigger than the spaceman
